doc.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

chapter: Working with Al Grey and Diva
title: Would she have taken a Basie alto chair?
summary: She says she would have loved a Basie alto chair; Rowe notes Junior Mance and Joe Williams on her list.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: No, you did not. I wonder if you had been offered, before you became a tenor player if you’d been offered to play one of the alto chairs in the Count Basie Orchestra, would you have taken the gig?
Absolutely. Absolutely. Because I was a lead alto player at that time and I would have loved that. That would have been a blast.
Yeah, I’ve dreamt of it myself.
Are you mostly an alto player?
Yes. What about, and I also saw Junior Mance and Joe Williams on your list. You couldn’t play with anybody good, ey?
